sentences.text:
ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
1.

After a brief submission to challenge the order passed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer in rejecting application under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short "the Act"), it is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the acquiring body i.e. the Gujarat Industrial Development Corporation (GIDC) has filed an appeal against the reference court award dated Teli Kadarbhai Hasanbhai vs State Of Gujarat on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86282795/
1 22.07.2022 passed in LAR No.31 of 1989.

entities.text: Teli Kadarbhai Hasanbhai vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Taking note of the above statement, we provide that the dismissal of the instant application filed by the petitioner based on the reference court award dated 22.07.2022 will not come in the way of the petitioner, in case he moves an application after disposal of the appeal filed by the GIDC.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/18293/2023 ORDER DATED: 18/10/2023 undefined 3.

The apprehension of learned counsel for the petitioner that in case the application is moved under Section 28-A of the Act after disposal of the appeal filed by the GIDC, the same may be rejected on the ground of delay is unfounded, inasmuch as, the reference court award, which is the basis of seeking enhanced compensation by moving an application by the petitioner, will be merged in the order of the First Appellate Court and the limitation for filing application under Section 28-A of the Act will have to be reckoned from the date of disposal of the first appeal.
4. We therefore provide that it would be open for the petitioner to move a proper application under Section 28-A of the Act after the disposal of the appeal.
5. With the above observations, the present petition stands disposed of.
